ruleDefinitions.name: User Risk and MFA Registration Policy Updated
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects changes and updates to the user risk and MFA registration policy.
Attackers can modified the policies to Bypass MFA, weaken security thresholds, facilitate further attacks, maintain persistence.
 Note: Unmapped fields: LoggedByService, Category, OperationName

sequences.query: (LoggedByService = "AAD\ Management\ UX" AND Category = "Policy" AND OperationName = "Update\ User\ Risk\ and\ MFA\ Registration\ Policy")
